articles.title: Working women face different challenges across life stages: PAP Women’s Wing survey
articles.summary: PAP Women’s Wing and NTUC Women and Family surveyed Singapore women, finding that early‑career staff report burnout, caregivers value flexible work, and only one in ten women with perimenopause or menopause symptoms feel their workplace is open to discuss support.
